intro: Woodgrove Acres is an HDB BTO project in Woodlands. It was launched on 16 June 2026, in HDB’s June 2026 BTO sales exercise. That official confirmation covers the launch date only. Completion and key-collection dates are unconfirmed; our project file notes that they are generally beyond 2027. A unit count is not in our file, so that field is left blank, as is tenure. Use your HDB documents for typologies and for any later key appointment. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Woodgrove Acres renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Woodgrove Acres interior
sections.text:
A June 2026 Woodlands BTO is still years from renovation, which is useful. When HDB issues your approved plan, the interior brief that usually pays off is built-in: a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall, with a built-in desk if a common bedroom will be a study. Maison specifies this as custom carpentry, not as IKEA-style furniture, and we can work in a wide room view or in closer studies of a wardrobe or a kitchen run. No official floor plan is on file, and we will not invent typologies or a typical Woodgrove Acres layout.

UrbanVille @ Woodlands, Woodgrove Ascent, Woodlands South Plains and Woodgrove Edge are unconfirmed near-completion or reported-complete pages in the same town and are not a guide to when Acres will get keys. Norwood Grand, already live, and Wynwood Grand, an EC launch recorded for a later window, are nearby links only. We will not invent walking times to Woodgrove, to Woodlands town, or to any MRT station.

Keep the official plan when it is issued. After keys, inspect defects and apply for the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals — an editorial allowance, not a promise. WhatsApp Maison with your official plan when you have it. We are not affiliated with HDB.
